slot_scores.name: missing_profit_maximization_objective
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the profit to be maximized (i.e., maximize total weekly profit subject to it being at least 3000 yuan), or is 3000 yuan simply a minimum requirement and the actual objective is something else (e.g., minimize total cost or maximize units produced)?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether the objective is to maximize total weekly profit, directly covering the hidden objective slot.

slot_scores.name: missing_idle_time_minimization_objective
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked about minimizing idle time or unused capacity, nor about any secondary objective weighted by process costs.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: The only objective is to maximize weekly profit; idle time minimization is not part of the optimization.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about idle time or a secondary objective, but its READY_TO_MODEL summary lists only profit maximization and omits any idle-time objective.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent resolved the P0 objective slot but stopped without resolving the P1 idle-time minimization objective, which was never asked about or confirmed.

summary: The agent correctly clarified the primary profit-maximization objective and several constraints, but it missed the P1 secondary objective of minimizing process idle time with cost-proportional weights and silently assumed profit maximization was the only objective.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
